badge_too_large.message: TextCache did not save a text in this tab: its size ($1) is over the limit ($2)

confirm_delete_all.message: Delete every saved text ($1 in all)? Deleted texts cannot be recovered. Your settings stay as they are.

confirm_delete_selected.message: Delete the selected saved texts ($1)? Deleted texts cannot be recovered.

empty_hint.message: Type into a text area or a rich-text editor on any web page, and the text shows up here.

ext_description.message: Saves what you type into text fields, so that it can be recovered.

list_detail_none.message: Pick a saved text from the list to read it here.

list_no_matches_hint.message: Try fewer or shorter words. The search looks at the address, the page title and the text.

load_failed.message: The saved texts could not be loaded: $1

options_autoClean_desc.message: Clean-up runs when the browser starts and once an hour. Deleted texts cannot be recovered.

options_dedupe.message: Remove older copies of the same text

options_dedupe_desc.message: When two saved texts hold the same text, only the most recently changed one is kept, whatever page it came from. This runs when you leave a text field and with every clean-up.

options_deleteAll_desc.message: Removes every saved text at once. Your settings and the list of pages to skip stay.

options_export_desc.message: Downloads a CSV file with the address, title, times and content of every saved text.

options_group_saving_intro.message: Text areas and rich-text editors are saved shortly after each change, however the change was made: typing, pasting, dictation or autocorrect. Single-line fields, such as search boxes and login forms, are never saved. Changes here reach open pages straight away.

options_invalid_keep.message: Enter a whole number, 1 or more. This value was not saved.

options_invalid_size.message: Enter a whole number, 0 or more. This value was not saved.

options_keepNewest_desc.message: Clean-up keeps this many of the most recently changed saved texts and deletes the rest.

options_language_desc.message: Automatic uses the language of your browser, or English if TextCache does not have it.

options_lead.message: TextCache keeps a copy of what you type into text areas, so you can get it back after a page crashes or a form is lost. Every change here is saved as soon as you make it.

options_maxItemKb_desc.message: A text bigger than this is not saved: the last version that fitted is kept, and the toolbar icon shows a badge on that tab. In rich-text editors the formatting (HTML) counts towards the size. 0 means no limit.

options_popupWidth_desc.message: How wide the window is that opens from the toolbar icon. It applies the next time the pop-up opens.

options_preview_none.message: With these settings the next clean-up deletes nothing. Saved texts: $1.

options_preview_off.message: Automatic clean-up is off, so saved texts are only deleted when you delete them.

options_preview_some.message: With these settings the next clean-up deletes $1 of $2 saved texts.

options_skip_desc.message: One entry per line. Nothing is saved on a page whose address contains an entry anywhere in it, so slack.com also covers app.slack.com. Embedded frames are checked against their own address.

popup_more.message: The newest $1 of $2 are shown here. The full list has them all.

popup_none_here_hint.message: Switch off "This site" to see the texts saved everywhere.
